description: This file defines the 'Gdpr' class in the 'Opencart\Catalog\Controller\Mail' namespace, which handles GDPR-related email functionalities within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It includes methods for sending GDPR-related emails and removing GDPR data entries, integrating with the system's models and mailing library. The class extends the system Controller class and manages email notifications related to GDPR actions such as data removal requests.

classes.name: Gdpr
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing GDPR-related email communications, including sending and removal of GDPR data requests.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the process of sending GDPR-related emails based on provided route, arguments, and output. Constructs email content, loads language data, manages store info, and sends emails through the Mail library.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes GDPR data entry identified by ID, updates status, loads relevant models to delete data, and sends a confirmation email if applicable.
